failure_type_1_solution_sample: Check the internal gears for damage.
inspect conveyor belt and repair or replace if damaged
Remove the non-pressurized air line to check for quad-ring blowby.
do not tighten the clamp too much
check that the signal cables for the fence is not damaged or miswired
update robot software again before you can use the robot
failure_type_2_solution_sample: Use M21 or the foot pedal to maintain pressure on the part.
Make sure there are no chips or obstructions on the bottom of the oil skimmer and on the edge of the coolant tank.
Inspect the coolant check valve for contamination and proper operation
Replace coolant periodically based on its condition
Ensure the TSC filter is not clogged
